sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hi, I have a job for you. I need an SVDS in the following config: black Magpul UBR GEN2 buttstock, SAG MK1 chassis, black Magpul MOE pistol grip, March Tactical 3-24x42 FFP scope and a suppressor. Ergonomics should be at least 10 and the recoil sum no higher than 500."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 36 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an SVDS to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,500 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 75,000 Roubles
  - 78,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 86,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Ratchet wrench
- 1× Bulbex cable cutter
- Unlocks purchase of AK Custom Arms AGS-74 PRO + Sniper Kit pistol grip at Skier LL4
"You're done? Excellent. Leave it on the table next to me, I'm a bit busy at the moment..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
SVDS specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 10 or more ergonomics
- 500 or less recoil
- A silencer
- A magazine with a capacity of 10 or no magazine
- AR-15 Magpul UBR GEN2 stock (Black)
- SVD SAG MK1 chassis
- AK Magpul MOE pistol grip (Black)
- March Tactical 3-24x42 FFP 30mm riflescope

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard SVDS from Prapor LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
